讚美之泉
詞、曲：曾祥怡

lines.a: 謙卑的君王 榮耀的君王
lines.b: Jesus, humble King, Jesus, glorious King
You gave up Your life for me
By dying on the Cross

lines.a: 謙卑的君王 榮耀的君王
lines.b: Jesus, humble King, Jesus, glorious King

lines.a: 我得醫治 因祢鞭傷
lines.b: By Your stripes I am healed

lines.a: 無盡恩典 我心感恩
lines.b: I am thankful for Your grace

lines.a: 十架的愛 何等奇妙
lines.b: Great is Your love poured out for me
More than words can ever say

lines.a: 洗淨我罪 脫離污穢
lines.b: Washed away my sins and my shame
You gave me garments of praise

lines.a: 十架的愛 何等奇妙
lines.b: Great is Your love poured out for me
Lord, my life never will be the same
I'm coming home into Your arms
Forever I will sing Your praise
Great is Your love
